responsibility: This target option-definition file describes the command-line options accepted by the eBPF backend and how GCC should materialize them into target variables and masks. It defines kernel-version selection, endianness, xBPF enablement, frame-size limits, CO-RE generation, ISA feature toggles such as jmpext/alu32/jmp32, and ISA version selection, along with the enums imported from bpf-opts.h, making it the source for generated option parsing and target flag declarations.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other same-stem BPF files, this is the target option specification consumed by GCC’s option-generation machinery, defining -m switches, enums, masks, and target variables such as endianness, kernel version, CO-RE, and ISA feature controls. It does not implement backend behavior like bpf.cc, describe machine RTL patterns like bpf.md, or define architectural ABI/register macros like bpf.h.
